  - \usepackage{longtable}

```{r tbs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

tibble(
  asset_item = c(
    "Housing \\& Land",
    "\\hspace{1.5em} Housing",
    "\\hspace{1.5em} Land",
    "Financial Assets \\& Fixed Capital of Personal Business",
    "\\hspace{1.5em}\\hangindent=1.5em\\hangafter=1 Fixed Capital of Personal Businesses",
    "\\hspace{1.5em} Cash, Deposits, Bonds \\& Loans",
    "\\hspace{3em} Deposits",
    "\\hspace{1.5em}\\hangindent=1.5em\\hangafter=1 Stocks, Business Equities \\& Fund Shares",
    "\\hspace{1.5em} Pensions \\& Life Insurance",
    "Offshore Financial Wealth",
    "Consumer Durables",
    "", "", "", ""
  ),
  asset_value = c(1510, 800, 710, 3518, 26, 684, 350, 1550, 1258, 241, 278, NA, NA, NA, NA),
  liability_item = c(
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
    "Debt",
    "\\hspace{1.5em}\\hangindent=1.5em\\hangafter=1 Debt Secured by a Mortgage",
    "Net Wealth",
    "\\hangindent=0em Net Wealth incl. Offshore Wealth and Consumer Durable Goods"
  ),
  liability_value = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 695, 400, 4333, 4852)
) %>%
  mutate(
    asset_value     = if_else(is.na(asset_value), "", as.character(asset_value)),
    liability_value = if_else(is.na(liability_value), "", as.character(liability_value))
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    col.names = c("Assets", "", "Liabilities and Net Worth", ""),
    align     = c("l", "r", "l", "r"),
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    escape    = FALSE,
    caption   = "Wealth Topography: Balance Sheet Example"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "5cm") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "1.5cm") %>%
  row_spec(13, extra_latex_after = "\\\\[6pt]")
```
